title.ko: au cas où + conditionnel, à condition que, à supposer que, sans + nom
title.en: Conditionals without si: au cas où + conditionnel, à condition que, à supposer que, sans, faute de

explain.ko: 프랑스어에서 si를 쓰지 않는 조건 표현이 있습니다. ① au cas où + 조건법: Au cas où vous auriez besoin d'aide, appelez-moi. ② à condition que + 접속법: Je viendrai à condition que tu sois là. ③ à supposer que / en supposant que + 접속법. ④ sans + 명사(없었다면): Sans votre aide, nous n'aurions pas réussi. ⑤ faute de + 명사: Faute de temps, nous avons annulé. ⑥ 부정사 + 주어를 도치한 문어체 Eussé-je su ...는 매우 격식적이어서 일반적으로는 Si j'avais su를 쓰세요.
explain.en: French has conditions without si. First, au cas où + conditional: Au cas où vous auriez besoin d'aide, appelez-moi. Second, à condition que + subjunctive: Je viendrai à condition que tu sois là. Third, à supposer que / en supposant que + subjunctive. Fourth, sans + noun (had it not been for): Sans votre aide, nous n'aurions pas réussi. Fifth, faute de + noun: Faute de temps, nous avons annulé. Literary inversion such as Eussé-je su … is very formal; normally use Si j'avais su.

head: 표현 / Expression

rows: Au cas où il pleuvrait, prends un parapluie.
À supposer que ce soit vrai, …

notes.ko: au cas où 뒤에는 접속법이 아니라 조건법을 씁니다.
notes.en: After au cas où use the conditional, not the subjunctive.

notes.ko: à condition que 뒤에는 접속법을 씁니다.
notes.en: After à condition que use the subjunctive.
sans + noun is the simple way to say 'had it not been for'.

examples.en: Had I known, I would have prepared.

examples.en: Should you need any help, please contact us.

examples.en: Were he to apologise, I still wouldn't forgive him.

examples.en: Had we heard the news, we wouldn't have come.

examples.en: Should the plan change, we will let you know.

Je viendrai à condition que tu ___ là.

lines.t: Qu'auriez-vous fait si vous aviez su à l'avance ?

trans.en: (Question) What would you have done had you known in advance?

options: Si j'avais su, je me serais mieux préparé.
Si j'aurais su, je me prépare.

lines.t: Que dois-je faire au cas où le programme changerait ?

trans.en: (Question) What should I do if the schedule changes?

options: Au cas où il changerait, je vous préviendrai.
Au cas où il changera, je préviens.

lines.t: Si j'avais su que l'événement serait annulé, je n'aurais pas réservé l'hôtel.
Au cas où l'annulation serait confirmée, ils rembourseront tout.

trans.ko:
A: 그 행사가 취소된다는 걸 알았더라면 호텔을 예약하지 않았을 텐데.
B: 환불은 받을 수 있어?
A: 취소가 확정되면 전액 환불해 준대.
B: 그럼 연락을 기다려 보자.
trans.en:
A: Had I known the event would be cancelled, I wouldn't have booked the hotel.
B: Can you get a refund?
A: Should the cancellation be confirmed, they'll refund in full.
B: Then let's wait to hear from them.

lines.t: Attention, tout le personnel. En cas d'urgence, suivez immédiatement les annonces. N'utilisez pas les ascenseurs, prenez les escaliers. Au cas où vous auriez besoin d'aide, adressez-vous au membre du personnel le plus proche.

trans.ko: 직원 여러분께 안내드립니다. 비상 상황이 발생하면 즉시 안내 방송을 따라 주세요. 엘리베이터를 사용하지 마시고 계단으로 이동하세요. 도움이 필요하시면 가까운 직원에게 알려 주세요.
trans.en: Attention all staff. Should an emergency occur, follow the announcements at once. Do not use the lifts; use the stairs. Should you need help, tell the nearest member of staff.

questions.q: Que doit faire le personnel en cas d'urgence ?
options: Suivre les annonces et prendre les escaliers
Rester à son poste sans bouger

lines.t: Au cas où vous voudriez une autre chambre, dites-le-moi. Je vais voir les disponibilités.
Merci. Une chambre calme serait parfaite.

trans.ko:
직원: 호텔 프런트입니다.
손님: 방을 바꾸고 싶은데요.
직원: 다른 방이 필요하시면 말씀해 주세요. 가능한 방을 확인해 드리겠습니다.
손님: 감사합니다. 조용한 방이면 좋겠어요.
trans.en:
Receptionist: Front desk.
Guest: I'd like to change my room.
Receptionist: Should you need another room, just say so. I'll check what's available.
Guest: Thank you. A quiet room would be great.

trans.en: 1) Had I known, I would have prepared. 2) Should you need any help, please contact us. 3) Were he to apologise, I still wouldn't forgive him.

items.passage: De nombreux habitants ont souffert lors des fortes pluies. Si l'alerte (1) donnée un peu plus tôt, les dégâts (2) moindres. Au cas où des pluies similaires reviendraient, la ville (3) à donner plus vite les ordres d'évacuation.

trans.ko: 그 도시에 폭우가 내렸을 때 많은 주민이 피해를 입었다. 경보가 조금만 일찍 발령되었더라면 피해는 줄었을 것이다. 앞으로 비슷한 폭우가 다시 온다면 시는 더 빠르게 대피령을 내릴 계획이다. 주민은 알림 서비스에 가입해야 한다.
trans.en: Many residents suffered when heavy rain hit the city. Had the warning been issued a little earlier, the damage would have been smaller. Should similar rain return, the city plans to issue evacuation orders more quickly. Residents are advised to register for the alert service.

items.passage:
COURRIEL
Modification du contrat
Au cas où vous souhaiteriez modifier les conditions du contrat, merci de nous en informer par écrit avant vendredi. Faute de demande, les conditions actuelles resteront en vigueur. Au cas où vous auriez d'autres questions, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter.

trans.ko:
이메일
계약 변경 안내
귀하께서 계약 조건을 변경하기를 원하시면 이번 주 금요일까지 서면으로 알려 주십시오. 변경 요청이 접수되지 않는다면 기존 조건이 유지됩니다. 추가 문의가 있으시면 연락 주십시오.
trans.en:
EMAIL
Contract changes
Should you wish to change the contract terms, please inform us in writing by this Friday. Were no request to be received, the existing terms will remain. Should you have further questions, please contact us.

questions.q: Que faut-il faire pour modifier le contrat ?
options: Informer l'entreprise par écrit avant vendredi

questions.q: Que se passe-t-il faute de demande ?

items.passage: Le client doit demander les modifications par écrit avant vendredi. S'il n'y a pas de demande, les conditions changent. Les clients peuvent contacter l'entreprise pour toute question.

trans.ko: 고객은 금요일까지 서면으로 변경을 요청해야 한다. 요청이 없으면 계약 조건이 바뀐다. 문의가 있으면 연락할 수 있다.
trans.en: The customer must request changes in writing by Friday. If there is no request, the terms change. Customers can contact the company with questions.

questions.q: Faute de demande, les conditions changent.

prompt.ko: 도치 조건문(Had, Should, Were)을 사용해 공식적인 안내문이나 후회를 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences using inverted conditionals (Had, Should, Were) in a formal notice or a regret.

task.model: Si j'avais su, je me serais préparé plus soigneusement. Au cas où le programme changerait, nous vous préviendrons immédiatement. Nous vous aiderons à condition que vous nous préveniez à l'avance. Sans votre aide, nous n'aurions pas réussi.

model_trans.ko: 미리 알았더라면 더 철저히 준비했을 것입니다. 일정이 바뀐다면 즉시 알려 드리겠습니다. 지원이 필요하시면 언제든지 연락 주세요. 그런 일이 다시 일어난다면 우리는 다른 방식으로 대응할 것입니다.
model_trans.en: Had I known, I would have prepared more thoroughly. Should the schedule change, we will let you know immediately. Should you need support, please contact us at any time. Were that to happen again, we would respond in a different way.
